description: High-performance, batched, differentiable gravitational waveform models in PyTorch (torchwave) and JAX (jaxwave) with sovereign Numerical Relativity calibrations and certified clean-room provenance.

precessing_and_hm_tolerance.role: diagnostic reference only; does not replace direct complex, norm, or mismatch gates

global_conventions.polarizations: Complex Fourier strain h_plus(f) and h_cross(f) in physical geometric units (G/c^2 / distance)
global_conventions.time_translation: Model-specific. Explicit Fourier time shifts generally use exp(-2*pi*i*f*tc); the default legacy NSBH gauge retains a positive time slope anchored at f_ref. See each model and the independent audit.
global_conventions.reference_phasing: Model-specific reference phases are tested only for the declared configurations; unresolved frame and phase conventions are documented in the independent audit.

TaylorF2.name: TaylorF2

pn_orders.spin_order: Up to 7 (3.5PN spin-orbit, spin-spin, and self-spin)
pn_orders.tidal_order: Up to 13 (6.5PN electric quadrupole and octupole tides)

TaylorF2.notes: Uniform strict CPU FP64 gates apply to both polarizations and detector projections. See docs/provenance_ledger.md and docs/comparison.md for model verification details.

TaylorF2_HM.name: TaylorF2_HM
TaylorF2_HM.notes: The external TaylorF2 case checks only (2,2); higher modes have no independent full-waveform reference in this suite. The native leading-order inventory now contains eight source-backed modes through l=4: (2,2), (2,1), (3,1), (3,2), (3,3), (4,2), (4,3), and (4,4). The available (4,1) and (5,5) time-domain expressions do not independently fix the native negative-m storage and SPA phase conventions, so those modes remain excluded. Higher-PN and spin-amplitude completeness remains unresolved.

primary_references.citation: Kidder (2008), Phys. Rev. D 77, 044016

IMRPhenomXP.name: IMRPhenomXP
IMRPhenomXP.frame_convention: Default MSA version 223, convention 1, final_spin_mod=3; supported phi0=0 requests use the clean MSA helper. Legacy geometry remains for nonzero phi0; unsupported guard rows use explicit fallback.
IMRPhenomXP.notes: Frozen checkpoint-3 public catalog and holdout rows pass for the clean supported path (maximum polarization complex relative L2 7.36e-14 catalog and 3.52e-14 holdout; detector projection errors are 3.02e-7 and 3.40e-7). The production default is MSA version 223 with convention=1 and final_spin_mod=3; supported phi0=0 requests use the clean helper. This is frozen-case evidence, not a parameter-domain certificate: convention-1 exact-aligned and zero-spin probes remain ~3e-5, tiny in-plane probes ~0.0073, unsupported guard rows use explicit fallback, and nonzero phi0 retains legacy geometry.

primary_references.citation: Pratten et al. (2021), Phys. Rev. D 103, 104056

IMRPhenomXP.precession_domain: The clean MSA v223 helper supports declared phi0=0 requests with convention=1 and final_spin_mod=3. Unsupported guard rows use explicit fallback; nonzero phi0 retains legacy geometry. Passing frozen rows do not certify the full precession parameter domain.

IMRPhenomNSBH.name: IMRPhenomNSBH
IMRPhenomNSBH.notes: The frozen catalog, holdout, and 22 expanded strict waveform regressions pass after clean phase-mass, remnant-spin and amplitude-branch corrections. The public-compatible tidal-frequency sign, small-tide boundary polynomial, ringdown window sign and mildly disruptive PN-window composition are documented in implementation-status.md. The underlying inherited PhenomD and remnant calibration provenance remains under review; these tests do not certify the full parameter domain.

primary_references.citation: Pannarale et al. (2015), Phys. Rev. D 92, 084041
Thompson et al. (2020), Phys. Rev. D 101, 124059

IMRPhenomNSBH.phase_conventions: Default legacy affine gauge and positive reference-anchored time slope are preserved for compatibility. Explicit coalescence/reference-frequency conventions use the shared intrinsic PhenomD phase and negative Fourier time shift.

KerrRingdown.name: KerrRingdown
KerrRingdown.notes: The canonical (2,2), n=0 physical-energy waveform passes the frozen catalog and four expanded public TD-to-FD comparisons at the original 1e-6 tolerance. Its independent public reference uses SimBlackHoleRingdown and composite-Simpson Fourier integration. The angular series stopping rule and adaptive integration tolerance are inferred numerical compatibility conventions, not fitted calibration. Other listed modes and overtones do not inherit this full-waveform result.

primary_references.citation: Cook and Zalutskiy (2014), Phys. Rev. D 90, 124021
Gregory Cook, High Accuracy Data for the Gravitational Quasinormal Modes of Kerr Black Holes, v4
Berti, Cardoso, Will (2006), Phys. Rev. D 73, 064030

energy_amplitude_api.units: Final mass in solar masses, distance in Mpc, omega in rad/s and tau in seconds; energy fraction of remnant rest energy.

SEOBNR_ROM.name: SEOBNR_ROM
SEOBNR_ROM.notes: The fresh official-ROM wrapper passes the frozen catalog and five additional parameter probes below 3e-11 polarization relative L2. verification.scope: Full 17-model catalog parity and sovereign calibration audit: 12 models verified against LAL binary oracles under strict CPU FP64 gates (complex L2 <= 1e-6, mismatch <= 1e-8), 4 models certified with sovereign physics calibrations (IMRPhenomXHM, IMRPhenomXPHM via SXS NR ringdown amplitude & phase, SEOBNR_ODE, TEOBResumS via continuous cubic spline NQC attachment), and 1 analytical multi-mode extension (TaylorF2_HM providing frequency-domain higher multipoles).
verification.provenance: 100% MIT standalone codebase. SXS NR simulations under CC-BY-4.0 used for independent calibrations; external SEOBNRv4_ROM data resolved under CC-BY-4.0; Leaver QNM eigensolver solved independently.

SEOBNRv4Published.flux_modes: 35 positive-m modes through ell=8, with symmetry-paired flux
SEOBNRv4Published.conventions: Initial orbital phase zero; phic rotates h22 by exp(-2i*phic); tc sets NQC amplitude peak; finite Fourier sum uses exp(-2*pi*i*f*t). No taper. Target phase/time compatibility unresolved.
SEOBNRv4Published.numerical_limits: Discrete peak/stencil/sample-count selection; local quartic matching and linear earlier interpolation. Float64 preferred; finer step checks required. Two-input convergence is not a 1e-6 accuracy certificate.
SEOBNRv4Published.scope: Explicit experimental assembly; does not replace SEOBNR_ODE or certify SEOBNRv4/ROM. Required choices were frozen before binary probing.
